in_marathi.name: Damodara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God who can be held in the hands
in_marathi.long_meaning: Damodara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Damodara is a name of Lord Krishna, which means 'God who can be held in the hands'. It is said that Lord Krishna, who is an embodiment of God, can be held in one's heart and mind, just as one holds a physical object in one's hands.
